name: blueprint/page-watch
description: Watch a page for change: fetch through guardedFetch, hash the normalized body, alert once on change with the delta
ingredients: hash of the normalized body (computed by the agent)
recipe: fetch the page -> normalize (strip volatile bits) and hash -> compare with the previous hash -> on change: extract the delta, notify once, store the new hash
pitfalls: dynamic pages hash-change every run - normalize timestamps and tokens out first
store the hash, not the full page - the delta is the story
